comment: Front matter cases that the build's reader (src/lib/markdown.mjs, through the yaml package as Astro reads it) and the tools' reader (tools/booklib/frontmatter.py) must read alike: the same data, or both an error. Both test suites run every case (src/plugins/tests/lib.test.mjs, tools/tests/test_booklib.py). "data": null means the page has no front matter.
